title: Choose the visual world for your portfolio
question: The roll assigned The Run-All Notebook. Keep it, take my pick or the category standard, or re-roll.

options.label: The Run-All Notebook
options.thesis: The site is a notebook you run: every section is a cell, and running it renders real output.
options.viewport: Cell [1] runs on load: name, AI Engineer, Bay Area, then its output is the Resume and Email actions; cell [2] sits queued below with the notebook shelf.
options.risk: Becomes costume if any code cell is fake; every code cell must be real code from his repos or the site's own build scripts.

raised.raise: One unbroken execution line with a now-marker: the running-cell indicator follows the reader down the page.
An eleven-step neutral ramp is the only tonal token set; the one accent means running/active and nothing else.
Every project has a front and a back: the output shows the result, the collapsed back holds stack, repo, and date.
One sans family across a wide size range; mono appears only where a notebook itself would use it.
Provenance seamed to every item: each note and project carries its date, source file, and link.
Depth by overlap only: no drop shadows; the active cell lifts by stacking over its neighbors.

options.label: The Preprint
options.thesis: The portfolio typeset as a paper: abstract, numbered sections, figures, and references to the notebooks.
options.viewport: Title block with name and affiliation, a 3-line abstract as the pitch, Resume and Email as the footnote links.
options.risk: Familiar: close to the editorial-serif look many portfolios land on, and it reads academic rather than shipping engineer.

options.label: Rhythm Machine Step Row
options.thesis: Career and notes as a sixteen-step pattern you program.
options.viewport: A sixteen-key step row with a running chase light.
options.risk: Recruiters and AI engineers don't live in this world.
options.case: Fuses poorly: loses audience identification and product clarity.

options.label: Darkroom Exposure Record
options.thesis: Translucent zone sheets with hatched densities.
options.viewport: Overlapping sheets over an eleven-step zone wedge.
options.risk: Opaque metaphor for a job-search audience.
options.kept: A strict tonal ramp as the only tonal tokens.

options.label: Cereal Box Aisle
options.thesis: Projects as boxes on a shelf, flip for the back panel.
options.viewport: A planogram wall of project boxes.
options.kept: Front panel for the result, back panel for the fine print.

options.label: Merz Collage Page
options.viewport: Scraps pasted at angles, no dominant axis.
options.risk: Chaos reads as disorganized to recruiters.
options.kept: Commitment to one type case used across many sizes.

options.label: Memory Quilt Atlas
options.thesis: Blocks that each carry a date and a history.
options.viewport: A quilt grid of unequal patches.
options.risk: Domestic warmth mismatches an engineering pitch.

options.label: Łowicz Layered Papercut
options.thesis: Depth built from pasted flat layers.
options.risk: Folk ornament has no tie to the subject.
options.kept: Depth from overlap, never from shadow.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean developer portfolio: hero, project grid, experience, contact, executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Name and role, two actions, then a project grid.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from other portfolios by design.
